page_title: CEL 1-0 GET | Celta Vigo v Getafe 04/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+1' Omar Alderete (Getafe) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Luis Milla (Getafe) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
89' Substitution. Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) has come on for Jonathan Bamba.
86' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
83' Excellent touch by Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
82' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) plays a through ball but overhits it.
79' A precise low pass is received by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
79' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
75' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Fran Beltran will be replaced by Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo).
74' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but David Soria is alert and denies him.
73' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.
71' The referee allows time for a substitution. Christantus Uche will be replaced by Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe).
70' Good chance! Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
70' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

70' Christantus Uche (Getafe) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him. Getafe force a corner. They send men into the box.
69' Getafe will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
69' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
67' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) replacing Anastasios Douvikas.
67' That will be all from Mihailo Ristic who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo).
65' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
63' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) latches onto a lofted pass from Oscar Mingueza on the edge of the six-yard box, but misdirects his header and sends it just wide of the left post.

62' OFF THE POST! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
62' Substitution. Alex Sola makes his way off the pitch and Peter Federico (Getafe) comes on as his replacement.
61' Carles Perez (Getafe) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
61' An attempted cross from Diego Rico (Getafe) is cleared.
60' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted!

59' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jesus Gil Manzano with no other option than to blow for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Getafe.
59' Alex Sola (Getafe) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
55' Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
54' Getafe are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
52' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Vicente Guaita.
52' Christantus Uche (Getafe) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
48' Alex Sola (Getafe) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
46' Half-time substitution. Claudio Giraldez decided to make a change. Javier Manquillo is replaced by Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) releases Anastasios Douvikas with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
42' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
41' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) heads on.
39' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
36' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Luis Milla (Getafe) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
36' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
35' Dangerous play by Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo). Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul. Getafe win a free kick.
34' The opposition can't get near Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the left post at the last second.
31' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nabil Aberdin trots off the pitch and is replaced by Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe).
31' Djene (Getafe) is being substituted because of an injury. Jose Bordalas Jimenez sends Juan Berrocal Gonzalez on the pitch.
30' Djene (Getafe) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
29' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
27' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at David Soria.
26' The free kick from long range, taken by Getafe, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
24' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.
23' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo).
22' Nabil Aberdin (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Jesus Gil Manzano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
21' Mihailo Ristic received a clever long ball from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert and managed to avert the threat.
19' A pass by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
18' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
13' Carles Perez (Getafe) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
11' Christantus Uche (Getafe) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
9' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle as Djene (Getafe) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Iago Aspas produces a brilliant lofted pass and Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) gets on the end of it to finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 1:0.
4' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) and Mihailo Ristic attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
2' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Getafe will take the kick-off.
